## Delinea Platform — Privileged Access Threat Hunting

Hunting queries over Delinea Platform audit events (`DelineaAuditEvents_CL`) for suspicious authentication and secret-access behaviour. Each tile is a starting point for investigation — tune thresholds to your environment.

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress), attrs = d.additionalAttributes | where EventName has 'MfaAuthentication' | extend MfaResult = tostring(attrs.MfaResult[0]) | summarize Failures = countif(MfaResult == 'Failed'), Successes = countif(MfaResult == 'Success'), FirstFailure = minif(TimeGenerated, MfaResult == 'Failed'), LastSuccess = maxif(TimeGenerated, MfaResult == 'Success') by Actor, SourceIP | where Failures > 0 and Successes > 0 and LastSuccess > FirstFailure | sort by Failures desc
content.title: Failed MFA followed by success (possible push-fatigue / brute force)

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress) | where ServiceType == 'Identity' and isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(Actor) | summarize DistinctIPs = dcount(SourceIP), IPs = make_set(SourceIP, 50), Events = count() by Actor | where DistinctIPs > 1 | sort by DistinctIPs desc
content.title: Users authenticating from multiple source IPs

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress) | where ServiceType == 'Identity' and isnotempty(SourceIP) and isnotempty(Actor) | summarize Events = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated) by Actor, SourceIP | where Events <= 2 | sort by FirstSeen desc
content.title: Rare user / source-IP pairs (<=2 events in range)

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name) | where (ServiceType == 'Secret Server' or EventName has 'Vault') and isnotempty(SourceIP) | summarize DistinctSecrets = dcount(SecretId), TotalAccesses = count(), Users = make_set(Actor, 25) by SourceIP | where DistinctSecrets > 5 | sort by DistinctSecrets desc
content.title: Single source IP accessing many distinct secrets

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name) | where (ServiceType == 'Secret Server' or EventName has 'Vault') and isnotempty(Actor) | extend Hour = hourofday(TimeGenerated), OffHours = iff(hourofday(TimeGenerated) < 6 or hourofday(TimeGenerated) >= 20, 'Off-hours', 'Business hours') | summarize Count = count() by Hour, OffHours | sort by Hour asc
content.title: Secret access by hour of day (off-hours highlighted)

content.query: DelineaAuditEvents_CL | extend d = parse_json(RawData) | extend ServiceType = tostring(d.service.type), EventName = tostring(d.eventType.name), Actor = tostring(d.actor.name), SourceIP = tostring(d.source.host.network.ipAddress) | where (ServiceType == 'Secret Server' or EventName has 'Vault') and isnotempty(Actor) | summarize Accesses = count(), DistinctSecrets = dcount(SecretId) by Actor | where DistinctSecrets > 10 | sort by DistinctSecrets desc
content.title: Users accessing an unusually high number of distinct secrets
